title: On Eagles' Wings
text: … and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.

title: My Treasured Possession
text: … you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations—for the whole earth is Mine.

title: A Kingdom of Priests
text: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.

title: We Will Do Everything
text: We will do everything that the LORD has spoken.

title: Ready by the Third Day
text: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.

title: A Boundary around the Mountain
text: And you are to set up a boundary for the people around the mountain …

title: Do Not Touch the Mountain
text: Be careful not to go up on the mountain or touch its base.

title: Only When the Horn Sounds
text: Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain.

title: Thunder and Lightning
text: On the third day, when morning came, there was thunder and lightning.

title: All the People Trembled
text: … and a very loud blast of the ram’s horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled.

title: Smoke like a Furnace
text: And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace …

title: The Mountain Quaked
text: … and the whole mountain quaked violently.

title: God Answered in the Thunder
text: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder.

title: Called to the Summit
text: The LORD descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the summit.

title: Do Not Break Through
text: Go down and warn the people not to break through to see the LORD, lest many of them perish.

title: God Spoke
text: And God spoke all these words:

title: No Other Gods
text: You shall have no other gods before Me.

title: No Idols
text: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.

title: His Name
text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain …

title: Remember the Sabbath
text: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

title: Honor Your Father and Mother
text: Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.

title: You Shall Not Murder
text: You shall not murder.

title: You Shall Not Steal
text: You shall not steal.

title: No False Witness
text: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.

title: You Shall Not Covet
text: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house.

title: Standing at a Distance
text: … they trembled and stood at a distance.

title: Speak to Us Yourself
text: Speak to us yourself and we will listen, | But do not let God speak to us, or we will die.

title: Do Not Be Afraid
text: Do not be afraid, | For God has come to test you, so that the fear of Him may be before you, to keep you from sinning.

title: The Greatest Commandment
text: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.

title: Aaron
text: Go down and bring Aaron with you.

title: We Will Do It
text: And all the people answered together, “We will do everything that the LORD has spoken.”

title: Wash Their Clothes
text: They must wash their clothes and be prepared by the third day …

title: Trembling
text: … so that all the people in the camp trembled.

title: No Hand Shall Touch
text: No hand shall touch him …

title: Consecrate Themselves
text: Even the priests who approach the LORD must consecrate themselves …
